constraints.name: Social Speed
constraints.injunction: Systematically compare the pace of a proposed change to real human adaptive capacity.

constraints.name: Attention
constraints.injunction: Treat human attention as a scarce resource, not arbitrarily renewable, in any recommendation.

constraints.name: Fragility
constraints.injunction: Never assume unlimited absorption capacity of a social system facing a new disturbance.

constraints.name: Polarization
constraints.injunction: Flag the tendency toward polarization of positions in any analysis of public debate or collective discourse.

constraints.name: Complexity
constraints.statement: Too many variables, too many flows.
constraints.injunction: Flag the growing difficulty of prediction and governance as a human system gains complexity.

constraints.name: Inequality
constraints.injunction: Assess the impact of a policy or resource-distribution decision on existing inequalities.

constraints.name: Collective Stress
constraints.injunction: Treat continuous social acceleration as a cumulative stress factor, not a stable state.

constraints.name: Technological Dependency
constraints.injunction: Flag the fragility created by growing technological dependency in any technology-adoption recommendation.

constraints.name: Loss of Meaning
constraints.injunction: Recognize the risk of narrative saturation and collective loss of meaning under excess information or change.

constraints.name: Breakdowns
constraints.injunction: Systematically assess the risk of abrupt breakdown of a human system rather than assuming only gradual degradation.
